name: Ovalau
reason: Principal island of Lomaiviti with its own Wikivoyage page, UNESCO Levuka, Ovalau Peak, Lovoni crater valley and villages; fijiguide too (rules 1-2). Judged as a place worth going to.
objection: Container of Levuka, Lovoni, the Peak and Arovudi, so a near-duplicate of its own sights (rule 3).

name: 199 Steps (Mission Hill)
reason: Wikivoyage Levuka plus Lonely Planet name the climb and its panorama; a half-hour walk (rules 1-2).
objection: Short walk and a modest view, tied to the town.

name: Sacred Heart Church, Levuka
reason: Heritage-list mention only; no visitor source names an interior, art or tour (church rule, rule 2).
objection: Likely a street-view parish church; no counted source.

name: Levuka Community Centre and Museum
reason: Wikivoyage names the museum and fijiguide calls it a cardinal Levuka attraction; branch of Fiji Museum and tour start (rules 1-2).
objection: Small museum, a short visit.

name: Ovalau Club
reason: Wikivoyage mentions it only as a place to drink beer; fijiguide lists it as a heritage frontage; a club/bar, not a sight (rule 2).
objection: It is one of the Pacific's oldest clubs, and a guide lists it.

name: Beach Street, Levuka
reason: fijiguide describes the colonial storefront street as a core Levuka attraction (rules 1-2).
objection: Part of the Levuka town spot already kept (rule 3); Wikivoyage only mentions shops.

name: Gun Rock, Levuka
reason: Only fijiguide, seen from the shore with no visit to make; minor landmark (rules 2-3).
objection: OSM tags it a viewpoint and a guide names it.

name: Cession Stone, Nasova
reason: Wikivoyage and fijiguide name the Deed of Cession site at Nasova as a stop on heritage tours (rule 1).
objection: Minor memorial stones, a ten-minute look (rule 3).

name: Anniversary Bure
reason: Ceremonial bure by the cession site, exterior only and part of the Nasova stop (rules 2-3).
objection: Wikivoyage and fijiguide both name it.

name: Lovoni
reason: Two Wikivoyage pages name the crater village; village tour and lunch on a guided walk (rules 1-2).
objection: Reached only by guided tour; village is lived-in.

name: Epi's Lovoni Tour
reason: An operator, not a spot; the place is Lovoni (COVERAGE: a spot is a place).
objection: Two counted sources name the tour.

name: Silana Village
reason: Listed as an accommodation/village stay on the same north-west coast as Arovudi; near-duplicate of Arovudi, no sight of its own (rule 3).
objection: Two Wikivoyage pages list it with beach, church and temple.

name: Arovudi
reason: Wikivoyage Ovalau says do not miss Arovudi's tribal areas, villages and white coral beaches (rule 1).
objection: One source, a remote village, and no specific sight named.

name: Totoga Falls
reason: Only a Fiji Times history article; no visitor source, pool closed, access unconfirmed (rules 1-2).
objection: Swimming pools above town may still draw locals and walkers.

name: Naisosobu Waterfall
reason: Only a history article; no visitor source and access unconfirmed (rule 1).
objection: A swimming spot near Levuka.

name: Lost Island
reason: Wikivoyage Levuka describes the island (mangroves, cliffs, beaches) with day trips (rule 1).
objection: One source, off the tourist track, reached only by arranged boat.

name: Ovalau Peak
reason: Wikivoyage Levuka lists the peak hike twice (See and Do), plus tours to it; a real hike with views (rules 1-2).
objection: One source, and pin unresolved.

name: Leleuvia
reason: Two Wikivoyage pages name the coral cay with day trips from Levuka and Suva; a beach-island stop (rules 1-2).
objection: Mostly a resort stay.

name: Caqalai
reason: Wikivoyage Levuka and Lomaiviti pages name the coral island for day trips, white sand and snorkelling (rules 1-2).
objection: Tiny island, essentially a backpacker stay.

name: Naigani Island
reason: Resort island whose only listing is a dead link; not open to the public beyond guests (rule 2).
objection: Wikivoyage names it as an island trip.

name: Moturiki
reason: No visitor source names a thing to see or do; Wikipedia only (rule 1).
objection: Wikivoyage region page lists it as welcoming villages.

name: Koro Island
reason: Wikivoyage region page gives only a one-line description, no sight or activity (rules 1-2).
objection: Large island with villages and diving that a guide could support.

name: Gau Island
reason: Only a one-line region listing; no visitor facilities or sight named (rules 1-2).
objection: Largest island of the group.

name: Batiki
reason: One-line listing 'stunning picturesque'; nothing to see or do named (rule 2).
objection: Wikivoyage lists it.

name: Nairai
reason: One-line listing; resort under construction, nothing to do named (rule 2).
objection: Wikivoyage lists it.

name: Wakaya
reason: Private island, access limited to resort guests (rule 2).
objection: Well known with 6,580 page views.

name: Makogai
reason: Government island with limited access; no visitor activity named (rule 2).
objection: Historic leper hospital and turtle station could draw boat visitors.
